own_solution.law: Newtonian energy conservation gives GMm/R = mv²/2. With M = (4π/3)ρR³, comparison with Earth gives v = 11.19(R/6371)sqrt(3.93/5.51) km/s. At R = 3390 km this is 5.02855 km/s; adding a same-density layer replaces R by R + q.
assumptions: The probe moves without further propulsion and reaches infinity with zero limiting speed.
The probe's gravitational effect on the planet is negligible.
Rotation, atmosphere and gravitational forces from other bodies are excluded as stated.
